work.description: The act attaches Uri and both Unterwalden cantons to the diocese of Basel, with canons and endowment conditions. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF9037; own dating clause LF9227–9230 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Mariam Maiorem sub annulo piscatoris die decimatertia sept. mil- lesimo octingentesimo trigesimo primo, pon- tificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF9098 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
